name: ultrademo-rerun
description: Moved to ultrademo-hq/ultrademo (npx skills add ultrademo-hq/ultrademo). This original version still refreshes videos made with it. Refresh an existing Ultrademo demo video after the app changed. Use when the user wants to re-run, update, refresh, or regenerate a demo video that already has a project folder (they shipped a UI change, a feature update, or just want current footage). Finds the project, re-captures, re-renders; unchanged narration stays cached.
